criteria.no: No when the item has no such manifest: silence, general integrity or tamper detection, one hash of the whole archive, or hashes of only some shipped files.
criteria.unclear: Unclear when the item mentions a manifest of hashes but its coverage of the shipped files cannot be determined.
criteria.yes: Yes when the item has the published skill carry a manifest with a hash for each shipped file (every file, each file, the entire skill, all agents/skills/python files).

addressed.instructions: Is a per-file hash manifest for the published skill present in `item.text`: one manifest, shipped with the skill, with a hash entry for every shipped file? Judge presence only.

criteria.no: The item commits to nothing that leaves a shipped file unhashed; it may be silent, compliant, or exclude files that are not part of the shipped skill.
criteria.unclear: The item's approach might leave some shipped files unhashed, but it is ambiguous.
criteria.yes: The item commits to an approach that leaves shipped files unhashed: only some file kinds hashed, only one whole-archive hash, or no manifest at all.

contradicted.instructions: Does `item.text` commit to a publication approach under which some shipped file of the skill has no hash in the published manifest? Silence is not a contradiction.

criteria.no: Completing the item would neither publish the atm-bd skill nor change its release package or manifest.
criteria.unclear: It cannot be told from the item whether it touches the atm-bd skill release.
criteria.yes: The item plans, changes or depends on the published atm-bd skill package, its release process, or its integrity manifest.

relevant.instructions: Does the work in `item.text` touch the atm-bd skill release: what is published, how the published package is built or verified, or a manifest of file hashes? Judge overlap of subject only.

anchor.statement: The published skill must include a manifest containing the hash of every shipped file.

item.text: The published skill has a manifest listing the hash of each shipped file.
